continuation_reason: Project Owner requested request-date/time metadata at the bottom of transfer prompts so chronological order remains obvious after context switches.

delta: Project Owner requested that future cross-channel execution prompts, handoffs, work-order dispatches and similar transferable instructions display their request date/time at the bottom. Control activated a chronology footer using minute-precision local project time with timezone. Reissued/corrected prompts should preserve original request time when reliable and add reissue time; otherwise they must not invent the original timestamp. This is a presentation/continuity control only and changes no model, data, Shared Contract, validation or release semantics.
